name: Bashana Runetotem
summary: On the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, Bashana Runetotem studies plants and corruption. She is the daughter of Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and aids the Cenarion Circle.

sections.title: A Daughter of the Circle
sections.body: Bashana Runetotem carries her father Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem’s druidic legacy on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise. While he guides tauren druids and advises Cairne Bloodhoof, Bashana studies unusual plants and regional threats. She gives travelers tools such as evergreen pouches to cultivate mysterious flora, including morrowgrain. She also coordinates Horde efforts against corruption spreading from places such as Blackfathom Deeps.

faq.answer: Bashana Runetotem is a tauren druid and researcher on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise. The daughter of Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, she studies unusual plants for the Cenarion Circle and organizes responses to natural threats across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What research does she conduct with morrowgrain?
aliases: what does bashana do with morrowgrain
faq.answer: Bashana asks Horde adventurers to cultivate and gather morrowgrain with seed packets and soil. The Cenarion Circle studies the herb’s unusual properties and its connection to other botanical mysteries across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is her connection to Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Bashana receives a report and proof from adventurers sent by Argent Guard Thaelrid to confront the cultists of Blackfathom Deeps. She rewards their help against corruption threatening Ashenvale.
Bashana is on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, near the druidic pavilions. The mesa is dedicated to the city’s shamans, druids, and spiritual elders.

angles.text: As a tauren druid learning under Hamuul, Bashana shows the fieldwork needed to understand Kalimdor’s changing ecology.
As a member of the Horde, you can look to Bashana to connect Thunder Bluff’s Cenarion Circle with champions fighting cultist threats.
